root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `read_long_names()` calls `atol (string)` on a candidate archive-header size field, the selected `string` must begin with a decimal digit.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable code only decides whether to copy `hdr->ar_size` into `buf` by inspecting the field's last byte. It does not enforce the additional digit-start precondition that `atol` needs before parsing the fixed-width archive field.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches `size_parse_sink` while `size_parse_guard.string_digit_guard_satisfied` is `0`. The authoritative fixed original is guarded at the first candidate header (it records the same false predicate at scan offset 8 and returns before `atol`). The closest source-grounded witness `first_ar_size_8065_boundary` mutates only the first header's `ar_size` field bytes at file offset 56 to the minimal digit-start decimal string `0000008065`, which makes the fixed run execute `atol (string)` once and then terminate the scan cleanly before any later false guard. That case is the genuine witness for the missing digit-start obligation.

nodes.state: The `atol (string)` sink consumes the same pointer selected for `string`, so the sanitizer-reported read executes on the carried archive-size bytes rather than on a reconstructed value.

On the crashing vulnerable iteration, `string` still equals `hdr->ar_size` after the copy-if-needed block, so libelf will parse the mapped fixed-width field directly instead of the NUL-terminated `buf` copy.

edges.relation: The exact pointer left in `string` after the fixed-width `ar_size` selection block is the same pointer later passed as the argument to `atol`.
